dialog.unsavedNote: You can save these changes first; choosing "Don't Save" discards everything since the last save, and "Cancel" returns to editing.
dialog.newWorkspaceNote: After saving, an empty workspace is created; "Cancel Save" discards changes since the last save and carries on, and "Cancel New" stays in the current workspace.
dialog.scriptTrustNote: Requests in "{{file}}" carry pre-request or post-response scripts. A script can read variables, request headers and the request body, rewrite the URL and the request, and send what it read to any address. Run them only if you trust where this .band file came from. This confirmation covers this one load: reopening the file or opening another workspace asks again.
dialog.firstRunNote: The app signs .band workspaces with a local key pair and uses it to decrypt files encrypted to you. The keys stay on this computer (in your user config directory) and are never uploaded. Enter an email as the display name, or leave it empty and the app picks a random one.
dialog.firstRunEmailPlaceholder: you@example.com (leave empty for a random one)
dialog.bandTrustNote: "{{file}}" is signed by the identity below, which this computer does not know yet. Trusting the public key opens files from the same signer directly from now on; "Trust once" applies to this opening only.
dialog.saveImport: Import a public key from a .band…
dialog.saveImportTitle: Take the signer's public key from a .band file's signature
dialog.saveReuseNote: No recipient checked = keep the existing recipients (only they can open the file).
dialog.saveCandidatesEmpty: No recipients yet: set up your identity first, or import a public key from a .band.
